sentences.text:
Shri Arvind Singh - Govt. Advocate for respondent/Stat
Heard on admission.
Appeal seems to be arguable, hence, admitted for final hearing.

I.A. No. 21546 of 2024 - an application for suspension of sentence and bail on behalf of both the appellants No.1 and 2 namely Anand Gour and Smt. Archana Gour who stood convicted under Sections 498A read with 34 of the IPC and Sections 3 read with 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 2 years and to pay fine of Rs. 5000/- each and R.I. for 1 year and to pay fine of Rs. 2000/- each respectively with default stipulations.
It is submitted that after conviction, sentence of appellants was already suspended by the trial Court upto 23.09.2024.

Considering the aforesaid, the coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 02.09.2024 has extended the suspension granted by the trial Court till the next date of hearing and when the matter was listed on 04.11.2025, again for a period of four weeks, the suspension was extended on the same terms and conditions.
Final disposal of this appeal will take sufficient long time, therefore, it is prayed that the remaining jail sentence of the appellants may be suspended and they be released on bail.
Learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the prayer and prayed for its rejection.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court deems it appropriate to allow the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

sentences.text: Accordingly, I.A. No. 21546 of 2024 is allowed and it is directed that the remaining jail sentence of the appellants shall remain suspended subject to the verification of the fact that the amount of fine has been deposited.

The appellants No.1 and 2 namely Anand Gour and Smt. Archana Gour be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) each with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for their appearance before the trial Court/concerning Court on 18.02.2026 and thereafter on such other subsequent dates as may be fixed in that behalf by the trial Court.
As the application for suspension of sentence is allowed by this Court, there is no requirement for consideration of I.A. No. 30872 of 2025 - an application for recall for bailable warrants.
As prayed for, I.A. No. 30872 of 2025 is dismissed as not pressed.
I.A. No. 30873 of 2025 - an application for urgent hearing during vacation is disposed of.
List this appeal for final hearing in due course.
